app.local: Tools and data stay on this device

permission.intro: Pixo needs these permissions to record the clipboard, place the quick panel beside the text field, and receive the keyboard. It adds itself to the list in System Settings. You have to turn each switch on.
permission.restart: If a switch is on but still shows as needed here, quit Pixo completely and open it again.
permission.accessibility: Places the quick panel beside the current text field, receives keys while it is open, and pastes a chosen item back into the app you were using.
permission.inputMonitoring: Lets the quick panel receive keystrokes while it is open.
permission.pasteboard: Records copies in the background. In System Settings, set Pixo to Always Allow.

json.description: Format, compact, and check JSON data.
json.invalid: Invalid JSON. Check your input and try again.
json.copyError: Could not copy. Please copy the result manually.

clipboard.description: Keep text, images, and file paths on this computer so you can copy them again.
clipboard.settingsDescription: Choose what to record, how long to keep it, and the shortcut for the quick panel.
clipboard.privacy: History stays on this computer and is never uploaded. You can review what is stored, and where, before turning it on.
clipboard.empty: Nothing here yet. Copied items will show up after you turn history on.
clipboard.panelHint: Copied. You can paste it now.
clipboard.panelHelp: Arrow keys choose an item. Enter copies and closes. {{option}}+Enter pastes it back. {{option}}+Shift+Enter pastes plain text. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. {{pin}} pins it and assigns a shortcut that copies it while search is empty. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel.
clipboard.panelHelpSelect: Click or press Enter to copy and close. Hold {{option}} and click, or press {{option}}+Enter, to paste back into the previous app. {{option}}+Shift+Enter pastes plain text. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. Arrow keys move and copy. {{pin}} pins an item and assigns a shortcut that copies it while search is empty. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel. Hold {{option}}+Shift while clearing to remove pinned items too.
clipboard.panelHelpPaste: Click or Enter pastes the item back into the previous app and closes the panel. Hold {{option}} to copy only. {{plain}} pastes plain text. Arrow keys move and copy. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. {{pin}} pins an item; with an empty search, its key pastes it. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel.
clipboard.copyOnSelect: Applies in the quick panel. Arrow keys copy the selected item without closing. When Paste automatically is off, click and Enter copy and close.
clipboard.pasteAutomatically: Clicking an item or pressing Enter pastes it back into the previous app and closes the panel. Hold {{option}} to copy only, and {{option}}+Shift to paste plain text. Arrow keys still only copy.
clipboard.enableBody: Pixo stores copied text, images, and file paths locally, and skips content the system marks as sensitive. You can pause, delete, or clear it at any time.
clipboard.cleared: Unpinned items were cleared. Pinned items remain.
clipboard.clearedAll: All items were cleared, including pinned items.
clipboard.clearConfirm: Clear unpinned items? Pinned items stay.
clipboard.clearAllConfirm: Clear every item, including pinned items?
clipboard.pasteNeedsAccess: Copied. Accessibility access is required to paste it back into the previous app.
clipboard.pasteUnsupported: Copied. Automatic paste is unavailable here, so paste it yourself.
clipboard.hintPaste: {{paste}}, or hold {{option}} and click, pastes back into the previous app.
clipboard.hintPasteAuto: Click or press Enter to paste back into the previous app. Hold {{option}} to copy only.
clipboard.hintPasteAccess: Without Accessibility access, the item is still copied and explained here.
clipboard.waylandShortcut: This Wayland session cannot register a global shortcut. Open the quick panel with pixo --clipboard-panel.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_one: Skipped {{count}} item over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_other: Skipped {{count}} items over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedExcluded_one: Skipped {{count}} item from an excluded app.
clipboard.skippedIgnored_one: Skipped {{count}} item matching an ignored type.
clipboard.fileMissing_one: {{count}} file is no longer at its original path. The list was still copied.
clipboard.fileMissing_other: {{count}} files are no longer at their original paths. The list was still copied.
clipboard.maxItems: Older unpinned items are removed after this many. Pinned items stay.
clipboard.retentionZero: Use 0 to keep items until the count limit removes them.
clipboard.excludedHelp: One app identifier per line. It must match the source shown on an item exactly.
clipboard.excludedPicker: Choose from the apps installed on this computer. Copies from a selected app are not recorded.
clipboard.excludedLimit: You can exclude up to 100 apps.
clipboard.excludedWayland: This Wayland session cannot identify the source app, so this exclusion list has no effect.
clipboard.ignoredTypes: One clipboard type per line. Matching copies are not recorded. Passwords and temporary copies still follow Skip sensitive content. Add com.apple.is-remote-clipboard to ignore Universal Clipboard.
clipboard.macosAccess: Opening Pixo asks for these system permissions. For the clipboard, choose Always Allow in System Settings.
clipboard.shortcutHelp: Click the field and press the new shortcut. Esc cancels. Include Command, Control, Option, or Shift. If the shortcut cannot be registered, this change is not saved.
clipboard.pinShortcut: Pins or unpins the selected item in the quick panel and the history list.
clipboard.deleteShortcut: Deletes the selected item immediately in the quick panel. The history list asks for confirmation first.
clipboard.shortcutNeedModifier: Press it together with a modifier key.
clipboard.kindDisabled: This kind of content is turned off in settings.

statusReason.wayland_no_data_control: This Wayland session does not offer a clipboard monitoring protocol.
statusReason.no_display: No usable display session was found.
statusReason.platform: Clipboard monitoring is unavailable on this platform.

error.unsupported: This action is not available in the current environment.
error.busy: The clipboard is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.too_large: The content is over the size limit.
error.file_missing: The original file no longer exists.
error.storage: The local history could not be saved.
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut could not be registered.
error.needs_confirm: This change deletes existing items and needs confirmation.
error.desktop_only: Clipboard history is available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.

system.trayIcon: Shown in the menu bar at the top of the screen.
system.autostart: Start Pixo automatically when you sign in.
system.background: Keep Pixo running after closing the window. On macOS, hide the Dock icon and use the menu bar to reopen or quit.
system.clipboardFeature: Turning this off stops clipboard history and its shortcut, and hides Clipboard in the left menu. Turning it on asks for confirmation first.
system.screenshotFeature: Turning this off stops the screenshot and recording shortcuts, hides Screenshot in the left menu, and the menu bar can no longer start a capture.
system.versionHelp: The version comes from this installation. Releases take their version from the GitHub tag, and this check compares it with the latest release.
system.updatePrompt: You are using {{current}}. The latest version is {{latest}}. Download and install the new version.
system.updateAvailable: Version {{version}} is available. Install it to update.
system.upToDate: This is the latest GitHub release.
system.updateError: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates.
system.error: Could not update the setting. Check system permissions and the menu bar icon, then try again.
system.desktopOnly: General settings are only available in the Pixo desktop app.

screenshot.description: Freeze the screen, then choose screenshot or screen recording at the top. After the selection, choose MP4 or GIF. The file is written to your save folder only when you download it.
screenshot.settingsDescription: Choose the shortcut, save folder, and whether Pixo hides itself. Choose Record at the top of a capture, then MP4 or GIF.
screenshot.desktopOnly: Screenshots are available in the Pixo desktop app.
screenshot.local: Screenshots and recordings are not uploaded. A recording stays out of your save folder until you download it. Copying follows your clipboard history settings.
screenshot.wayland: This Wayland session cannot capture silently.
screenshot.permission: Allow Pixo to record the screen before taking a screenshot.
screenshot.relaunch: macOS saved the permission. Quit and reopen Pixo, then try again.
screenshot.ocrHelp: After you select an area, choose Extract text on the toolbar. Recognition stays on this computer. The result is shown so you can copy it.
screenshot.ocrUnsupported: Text extraction is not available on this system.
screenshot.ocrNeedSelection: Select the area to read first.
screenshot.recordLater: After you start a capture, choose Record at the top. When the selection is done, choose MP4 or GIF.
screenshot.recordEntry: After you start a capture, choose Record at the top. When the selection is done, choose MP4 or GIF.
screenshot.recordHint: After the selection, choose MP4 or GIF. Download puts the file in your save folder. Close discards it.
screenshot.scrollModeHint: Scroll capture starts after the selection.
screenshot.scrollManual: Scroll up or down with the wheel inside the selection.
screenshot.scrollAutoOn: Scrolling down automatically. The wheel still works.
screenshot.scrollNeedSelection: Select a taller area before scroll capture.
screenshot.scrollNeedsAccess: Scroll capture needs Accessibility permission. Allow Pixo in System Settings, then try again.
screenshot.scrollStill: No new area was captured. Point at the scrolling content, use the wheel, and try again.
screenshot.copiedNoHistory: Copied. The image is too large for clipboard history.
screenshot.displayChanged: The displays changed, so this capture was cancelled.
screenshot.truncated: Only the first 8 displays are shown.
screenshot.hideSelf: Hide Pixo’s windows when a shortcut or the menu bar starts a capture.
screenshot.recordShortcut: Press it to open the screen with Record already selected, then drag a selection.
screenshot.saveDir: The default folder is Pixo inside Pictures. Choose folder opens the file manager. Downloaded images and recordings are written here.
screenshot.scrollHeight: The stitched image will not exceed this height.
screenshot.scrollAuto: When on, scroll capture moves the page down by itself. When off, scroll inside the selection yourself.
screenshot.shortcutHelp: Focus the field and press a new combination. Esc cancels. Include Command, Control, Option, or Shift.
screenshot.shortcutNeedModifier: Press it together with a modifier key.

error.busy: A capture is already in progress.
error.not_found: That pin could not be found.
error.storage: The image could not be saved.
error.invalid_input: That annotation could not be saved.
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut could not be registered.
error.pin_limit: The screen already has 8 pins. Close one first.
error.desktop_only: Screenshots are available in the Pixo desktop app.
